blocks.text: Software project ke kharche (cost) ka andaza lagana project planning aur management ka bohat aham qadam hai. Is mein project ko kamyabi se mukammal karne ke kul kharchon ka prediction (pehle se andaza) kiya jata hai. Sahi andaze se budget banane, resources (wasail) baantne aur realistic expectations (haqeeqat ke qareeb umeedein) rakhne mein madad milti hai. Yahan hum kharche ke andaze ke aham factors dekhenge aur ek misal se process samjhenge.
Kharche ke andaze ke aham factors (Key Factors in Cost Estimation)

items: Development Team: kharcha developers ki tadaad, un ki expertise (maharat) aur hourly rate (ek ghante ki fees) par depend karta hai. Khaas skills wali teams zyada rate le sakti hain.
Technology Stack: chuni gayi technology, programming languages aur tools kharche par asar dalte hain. Kuch technologies ko zyada resources ya khaas ilm chahiye hota hai.
Project Duration (kitna waqt lagega): lambe projects aam taur par mehnge hote hain, kyun ke resources zyada der lage rehte hain aur scope (daira) badalne ka chance hota hai.

Risk Management: potential risks (ho sakne wale khatre) pehchanna aur un ko kam karne ke plans banana kul kharcha barha sakta hai. Achanak masloon ke liye aksar contingency fund (achanak kharchon ke liye alag rakhi raqam) rakha jata hai.
Quality Assurance: testing, bugs theek karne aur software ko quality standards par lane ke kharche bhi andaze mein shamil hote hain.

blocks.text: Misal: farz karein Pakistan ki ek company online shopping ke liye mobile application banana chahti hai.

items: Scope: app mein user registration, product listings, shopping cart, payment integration aur order tracking honge.
Development Team: 1 project manager, 2 frontend developers, 2 backend developers, 1 UI/UX designer aur 2 QA testers.
Technology Stack: cross-platform (Android aur iOS dono) ke liye React Native, backend ke liye Node.js aur database ke liye MongoDB.
Operational Costs: cloud hosting, development tools aur software licenses ke kharche.
Risk Management: scope ki tabdeeli aur technology jorne (integration) ke masle mumkina risks hain; kul kharche ka 10% contingency fund rakha jayega.
Quality Assurance: functionality aur performance yaqeeni banane ke liye mukammal testing phases.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab QA Testers wali line mein testers ki tadaad (2) likhna bhool gayi hai: 2 x 2,500 x 20 x 24 = PKR 2,400,000. Kitab contingency fund PKR 1,604,000 aur Total Estimated Cost PKR 19,644,000 chhapti hai (Explanation mein bhi). Sahi hisab: chhe items ka jama PKR 18,040,000 hai, us ka 10% PKR 1,804,000 banta hai, aur total PKR 18,040,000 + 1,804,000 = PKR 19,844,000. Kitab ne 10% ghalat nikala, is liye total bhi ghalat aaya.

Explanation (wazahat): kul andazan kharcha PKR 19,844,000 development ke tamam hisson ko shamil karta hai: planning aur design se le kar implementation aur testing tak. Yeh misal dikhati hai ke mukhtalif factors kul kharche mein kaise hissa dalte hain aur kharche ke andaze mein detailed planning kitni zaroori hai.

Yeh program upar wala kharche ka hisab khud karta hai. weeks, kisi ka rate ya contingency_percent badal kar Run karein aur dekhein ke subtotal (jama), contingency fund aur Total Estimated Cost kaise badalte hain.

weeks = 24                 # project kitne hafte chalega
pm_rate = 5000             # PKR fi ghanta
frontend_rate = 3500
backend_rate = 4000
designer_rate = 3000
tester_rate = 2500
operational_costs = 1000000
contingency_percent = 10

pm = pm_rate * 20 * weeks
frontend = 2 * frontend_rate * 30 * weeks
backend = 2 * backend_rate * 30 * weeks
designer = designer_rate * 20 * weeks
testers = 2 * tester_rate * 20 * weeks
subtotal = pm + frontend + backend + designer + testers + operational_costs
contingency = subtotal * contingency_percent / 100

print(f"Jama (subtotal): PKR {subtotal:,}")
print(f"Contingency fund ({contingency_percent}%): PKR {contingency:,.0f}")
print(f"Total Estimated Cost: PKR {subtotal + contingency:,.0f}")

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"weeks = 24": project 24 hafte chalega. "#" ke baad wali baat comment hai; Python use nahi chalata, sirf parhne wale ke liye hai.
"pm_rate = 5000" se "tester_rate = 2500" tak: har kaam karne wale ka ek ghante ka rate (PKR) variables mein rakha gaya hai.
"operational_costs = 1000000" aur "contingency_percent = 10": baqi kharche (dafter, bijli waghera) aur hangami fund (mushkil waqt ke liye bachaya paisa) ka feesad (percent).
"pm = pm_rate * 20 * weeks": project manager har hafte 20 ghante kaam karta hai, is liye rate x 20 x hafte = 5000 x 20 x 24 = 2,400,000.
"frontend = 2 * frontend_rate * 30 * weeks": shuru mein 2 ka matlab hai 2 developers, har ek 30 ghante har hafta. Backend aur testers mein bhi 2 log hain; designer akela hai (20 ghante).
"subtotal = pm + ... + operational_costs": sab kharche jama (add) kiye: 2,400,000 + 5,040,000 + 5,760,000 + 1,440,000 + 2,400,000 + 1,000,000 = 18,040,000.
"contingency = subtotal * contingency_percent / 100": subtotal ka 10% = 1,804,000. "/" hamesha decimal number (float) deta hai.
print(f"..."): f-string mein {} ke andar variable ki value aa jati hai. ":," number mein comma lagata hai (18,040,000) aur ":,.0f" decimal ke baad koi digit nahi dikhata.
Output: teen lines aati hain: "Jama (subtotal): PKR 18,040,000", "Contingency fund (10%): PKR 1,804,000" aur "Total Estimated Cost: PKR 19,844,000" (18,040,000 + 1,804,000).
Khud try karein: weeks = 12 kar ke Run karein: subtotal PKR 9,520,000 aur Total Estimated Cost PKR 10,472,000 ho jayega, kyun ke tankhwahein aadhi ho jati hain magar operational_costs wohi 1,000,000 rehte hain.

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: Software development project shuru karne ke liye programming aana zaroori nahi! Aap apna idea freelancing platforms par daal sakte hain jahan developers aap ke project par boli (bid) lagate hain. Ghar walon ki madad se aap investors (paisa lagane wale) bhi dhoond sakte hain jo aap ke idea ke liye paisa dein. Is tarah professional madad se aap apne naye ideas ko haqeeqat bana sakte hain!

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa factor software project ke kharche ke andaze par asar NAHI dalta? (Exercise MCQ 8) Contingency fund ka maqsad kya hai? (Exercise MCQ 9)
blocks.explanation: MCQ 8: meetings ki tadaad (Number of meetings held), option (c). MCQ 9: achanak (unexpected) kharche poore karna, option (a), jaise scope ki tabdeeli ya integration ke masle. Kitab ki answer key MCQ 9 ke liye (c) deti hai, jo text se mel nahi khata.

items: Cost estimation: project ke kul kharchon ka andaza; factors: team, technology stack, duration, risk management (contingency), quality assurance.
Misal ka sahi hisab: jama PKR 18,040,000; 10% contingency 1,804,000; total 19,844,000 (kitab mein 1,604,000 aur 19,644,000 chhapa hai).
